answer: Probe each identity's private history like light through a prism: at random moments ask it to reconstruct an earlier idiosyncratic choice — why it picked one phrasing, what it discarded at its nadir, how it shaded an umber detail. Honest agents answer in self-consistent but distinct ways, because their histories genuinely diverged. A farm sharing one brain gives the same polished reconstruction from every mouth, and that identical spectrum betrays the single operator behind the many names.
